style: Botanical-clinical glass-skin aesthetic carried over verbatim from the locked poster (snail-mucin-poster-spike.html): soft sage gradient ground with ghosted leaf silhouettes, glossy opalescent bubble highlights, an illustrated glass dropper bottle (silver ridged collar, white dropper bulb cap, pale-green bubbled serum) with two spiral-shell tan-bodied snails and their signature seafoam-to-gold-to-lilac slime trails flowing down the glass. Display type is Bricolage Grotesque (kicker/headline/descriptor/stat numerals+labels) paired with Noto Serif TC for the Chinese subhead and stat CN labels. Calm, confident, high-craft editorial pacing — not loud or gimmicky. No brand mark of any kind: this piece is unbranded, unlike the sibling PDRN poster/video.
shot_brief: The viewer opens on the same botanical-clinical world as the locked snail-mucin poster: a soft sage gradient with ghosted leaves already in place, and the illustrated glass dropper bottle — two spiral-shell snails perched on its glass — draws in as their signature opalescent slime trails animate down the glass in a seafoam-to-gold-to-lilac stroke reveal, the piece's one dominant motion idea. Against that settling illustration, 'SNAIL' kicks up and 'MUCIN' lands with a confident punch, then the ingredient descriptor and the Chinese subhead 蝸牛黏液精華 cascade in beneath it to build credibility, before the two proof beats — '05 活性成分 Key Actives' and '04 肌膚功效 Skin Benefits' — land in a paired call-and-response rhythm inside their glassy callout discs. The piece closes on a ~2.8s hold of the fully assembled composition — headline, descriptor, subhead, both stats, and the illustrated bottle all legible together, bubbles drifting gently — so it reads as a complete, screenshot-worthy motion poster rather than a rushed reveal.

hook-headline: kinetic-beat-slam — hero-word 'MUCIN' slam entrance (scale+blur, power4.out), but capped to a restrained back.out(1.4-1.6) settle rather than the base vocabulary table's literal back.out(2.2), which reads too playful for this glossy/premium tone

spring-pop-entrance — calm variant (power3.out, Y_RISE <=12px) for the bottle group's draw-in and each snail's settle onto the glass, staggered ~0.1-0.15s apart, snail A (large) before snail B (small)

svg-path-draw — the twin slime-trail stroke-dasharray/dashoffset draw-on (measured getTotalLength(), power2.out, never back.out — 'pens don't bounce'), staggered at ~70-80% per svg-path-draw's own multi-path guidance, using its 'draw then fill' variation so each trail's seafoam-to-gold-to-lilac glow path cross-fades in just behind its own drawn stroke
build-descriptor: word_reveal + fade_blur — base motion-vocabulary primitives for the three co-equal terms, ~0.15-0.2s stagger
depth-of-field-blur — the filter:blur() tween discipline behind the fade_blur settle
no caption-* catalog block forced — this beat's calm, unweighted cascade doesn't match any of the 18 named gimmick blocks
build-subhead-cn: slide_bottom + fade_in — base motion-vocabulary primitives only; deliberately unadorned bridge beat between the hook's slam/draw-on energy and the punchier stat pair to come
punch-stat-actives: spring-pop-entrance — the glassy callout disc's scale_grow (scale 0->1, power3.out, transform-origin center)

counting-dynamic-scale — numeral 00->05 count + synced scale grow, power2.out, compressed to ~0.5-0.6s (shorter than the rule's 1.2-2.5s default — appropriate for a trivial single-digit count); tabular-nums mandatory; per that rule's own constraint NO back.out/scale_punch bounce on the numeral itself ('it's data, not decoration') — punch comes from the disc's pop + the count's speed, not a bounce
word_reveal — CN label '活性成分' + EN caption 'Key Actives', ~0.15s behind the numeral's count-start
punch-stat-benefits: exact mirror of punch-stat-actives's mechanism (spring-pop-entrance disc + counting-dynamic-scale 00->04, same compressed duration, same no-bounce discipline) — a deliberate MATCHED pair, not a varied beat: kinetic-beat-slam's 'distinct entrance per phrase' guidance is intentionally set aside here because the design intent is call-and-response repetition
resolve-hold: titlecard-reveal (blueprint) — its Scene-3 stillness discipline: the hold IS the deliverable, not an unanimated gap

sine-wave-loop — bounded onUpdate breathe for the ~10-13 bokeh bubbles, LOW amplitude (scale ~+/-0.01, y ~+/-2-3px), damped to default/sqrt(N) since many run concurrently, periods staggered (2.1s/1.9s/2.4s/2.6s...) so they read as one collective breath

sine-wave-loop — the slime-trail's 'slow shimmer' as a bounded sine-driven micro-shift on gradient position/opacity, NOT ambient-glow-bloom's shimmer-sweep variant (that is reserved for in-progress status text, which doesn't semantically fit a finished, resolved trail); alternative: a single one-pass ambient-glow-bloom traveling sweep early in the hold that fades and never repeats
ambient-glow-bloom — optional hero-bloom polish (peak opacity <=0.3) softly behind the bottle

customize.composition_structure_note: This is a CUMULATIVE single-composition build, not a hard-cut montage: every element that enters across scenes 1-5 remains visible through resolve-hold — nothing exits mid-piece, matching the pdrn-skin-regeneration sibling's one-continuous-timeline precedent. Layout follows the poster's fixed absolute-positioned illustration (NOT the generic flex-centered-group pattern kinetic-type's default hand-author guidance describes) — each scene's content layers into its own fixed-position region of one persistent stage, each element entering via its own explicit GSAP fromTo() per builder-contract.md.
customize.dominant_motif: the glossy opal stroke-draw reveal (seafoam -> gold -> lilac) established on the slime trails at the hook; the resolve-hold's bounded ambient shimmer is a reprise of this same motif, not a new one — keeps the piece to ONE dominant motif per the director heuristics.
customize.pattern_interrupt: at ~4.4s (punch-stat-actives) the piece shifts from the calm vertical text-cascade of build-descriptor/build-subhead-cn into a punchier paired call-and-response rhythm for the two stat beats — the one deliberate energy change in an otherwise calm, editorial piece, per the '>2.5s runtime needs exactly one pattern-interrupt' heuristic.
customize.no_brand_mark: confirmed carried forward — the source poster already has no logo/wordmark; resolve-hold must not introduce one (no URL pill, no logo lockup) — the piece resolves on the product illustration itself, per the user's explicit no-brand-mark constraint.

scenes.motion: kicker 'SNAIL' fade_in + slide_bottom (base vocabulary primitives) lands ~0.15s. Hero word 'MUCIN' slams in via kinetic-beat-slam's scale+blur entrance (scale 1.4->1, blur 10px->0, power4.out, ~0.4s) with a restrained back.out(1.4-1.6) settle on landing — not the vocabulary table's literal back.out(2.2), which reads too playful for this glossy/premium tone — resolved by ~0.9s. Concurrently (0-0.4s) the illustrated bottle group draws in via spring-pop-entrance's calm variant (scale 0->1, power3.out, Y_RISE <=12px, 'a weighted, confident landing'); snail A (large, upper) and snail B (small, lower) settle ~0.1-0.15s apart on the same calm spring-pop, snail A first. From ~0.4s the twin opalescent slime-trails draw on via svg-path-draw: each trail's pearl-highlight stroke animates stroke-dashoffset (measured getTotalLength()) at power2.out; trail A (from snail A) runs ~0.4-1.0s, trail B staggered to start at ~70-80% of trail A's duration (~0.8-0.85s) and finish ~1.4s; each trail's filled seafoam-to-gold-to-lilac glow path cross-fades in (fillOpacity 0->0.55) just behind its own stroke per svg-path-draw's 'draw then fill' variation, completing by 1.6s. This stroke-draw + glow-fill is the piece's one dominant motif, reprised (not repeated) as a bounded ambient shimmer in resolve-hold.

word_reveal stagger left-to-right across the three middle-dot-separated terms (~0.15-0.2s apart — wider than a dense-sentence default since there are only three, unhurried co-equal terms), each settling via fade_blur (opacity 0->1, blur 14px->0, power1.out per depth-of-field-blur's tween discipline), ink-moss color, no scale/bounce on any term — genuinely co-equal weight, no single term emphasized. Hand-authored from base vocabulary primitives; no caption-* block forced.

slide_bottom + fade_in (base vocabulary primitives, power4.out), Noto Serif TC weight settling into its static 60px/900-weight resting state, brief hold before the next beat. Deliberately unadorned — the calm bridge between the hook's slam/draw-on energy and the punchier stat pair to come.

glassy callout disc scale_grow in via spring-pop-entrance (scale 0->1, power3.out, transform-origin center — matches the poster's circular glass-bubble surface). Numeral '05' counts 00->05 via counting-dynamic-scale: a proxy value and the numeral's own scale grow (~50%->100%) share ONE tween, power2.out, compressed to ~0.5-0.6s (shorter than the rule's default 1.2-2.5s range — a trivial single-digit count reads sluggish at full length); tabular-nums mandatory. No back.out/scale_punch bounce on the numeral itself, per counting-dynamic-scale's own constraint — the punch comes from the disc's pop and the count's speed, not a bounce. CN label '活性成分' + EN caption 'Key Actives' word_reveal in ~0.15s behind the numeral's count-start.

exact mirror of punch-stat-actives's mechanism (spring-pop-entrance disc + counting-dynamic-scale 00->04 count, same ~0.5-0.6s compressed duration, same no-bounce discipline) at a ~0.15s stagger offset — a deliberate MATCHED pair for a paired call-and-response rhythm, not a varied beat: kinetic-beat-slam's usual 'distinct entrance per phrase' guidance is intentionally set aside since the intent here is repetition, not variety. CN label '肌膚功效' + EN caption 'Skin Benefits' word_reveal follows the same ~0.15s-behind pattern.

scenes.motion: Ambient hold only, per the titlecard-reveal blueprint's stillness discipline — the hold IS the deliverable, not an unanimated gap; no new entrances, nothing from scenes 1-5 exits. Bokeh bubbles (~10-13, carried over from the poster) drift via sine-wave-loop's bounded onUpdate form: low amplitude (scale ~+/-0.01, y ~+/-2-3px), damped to default/sqrt(N) since many run concurrently, periods staggered (2.1s/1.9s/2.4s/2.6s...) so they read as one collective breath, not competing jitter. The slime-trail gradient carries its slow shimmer as a bounded sine-driven micro-shift on gradient position/opacity (same sine-wave-loop mechanism — not an infinitely-repeating shimmer-sweep, which ambient-glow-bloom reserves for in-progress status text); optionally a single one-pass ambient-glow-bloom traveling sweep early in the hold (once, fades, never repeats) as an alternative. A soft ambient-glow-bloom hero-bloom (peak opacity <=0.3) behind the bottle is an optional polish add. Final frame reads as the complete locked-poster composition — headline, descriptor, CN subhead, both stat callouts, and the illustrated bottle all legible together — screenshot-worthy, no brand mark anywhere.
